# Chennai northeast monsoon: wet and dry spells.
# Run with shiny::runApp("app") from the project folder, or open this file in
# RStudio and press Run App. Files in R/ are loaded automatically first.
# The same app runs in a web browser through Shinylive: see deploy/build_site.R.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(shiny)
  library(bslib)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggiraph)
})

# Chart text uses the bundled DM Sans; without it, charts fall back to the system sans
try(register_chart_font("www/fonts"), silent = TRUE)

# Data and the full-record results used on several pages --------------------------
days    <- load_days("data")
audit   <- load_audit("data")
pre     <- load_precomputed("data")   # slow simulations, made by prepare/precompute.R
ond     <- select_days(days, 10:12, "All years")
n_used  <- length(unique(ond$season))
record_years <- sum(!is.na(ond$wet)) / 92

chain_all  <- fit_chain(ond)
h2_all     <- test_h2(ond)
h4         <- test_h4(ond)
h5         <- test_h5(ond)
fits       <- pre$fits
lambda     <- wet_rate(ond)
best_fit   <- fits$fits[[fits$best_aic]]
dry_max    <- pre$dry_max
spells_all <- pre$spells[[spell_key("Oct to Dec", "All years")]]
use_second_order <- h2_all$p < 0.05
alert_tab  <- alert_states(ond, chain_all, h2_all, best_fit, h5$q95, use_second_order)

get_returns <- function(dist) pre$returns[[dist]]

# Small text helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
p_text <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", num(p, 3))
chi_text <- function(stat, df, p) {
  HTML(sprintf("χ² = %s, %d df, %s", num(stat, 1), as.integer(df), p_text(p)))
}
join_and <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 1) x else paste0(paste(x[-n], collapse = ", "), ", and ", x[n])
}
plural <- function(n, word) paste(n, if (n == 1) word else paste0(word, "s"))
months_label <- function(m) if (m == "Oct to Dec") "October to December" else m

test_block <- function(tag, question, answer, stats, note = NULL) {
  div(class = "test",
      div(class = "test-q", span(class = "test-tag", tag), question),
      p(class = "test-a", answer),
      p(class = "test-s", stats),
      if (!is.null(note)) p(class = "test-s", note))
}
fact_item <- function(value, label) {
  div(class = "fact", div(class = "fact-v", value), div(class = "fact-l", label))
}
spec_item <- function(label, value) {
  div(class = "spec", div(class = "spec-l", label), div(class = "spec-v", value))
}
legend_item <- function(key, label) span(class = "li", span(class = paste("key", key)), label)
page_head <- function(title, lede_id = NULL, lede = NULL) {
  div(class = "page-head", h1(title),
      if (!is.null(lede_id)) uiOutput(lede_id, class = "lede") else p(class = "lede", lede))
}
caption <- function(...) p(class = "caption", ...)

# UI ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The stock Bootstrap 5 theme comes precompiled, so nothing is compiled at start-up
# (slow inside a browser). Fonts, colours and shapes are set in www/styles.css.
fit_choices <- setNames(fits$table$dist, fits$table$name)

ui <- page_navbar(
  title = span(class = "brand", span(class = "brand-dot"), "Chennai monsoon spells"),
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5),
  fillable = FALSE,
  navbar_options = navbar_options(underline = FALSE),
  header = tags$head(tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "styles.css"),
                     tags$link(rel = "icon", type = "image/svg+xml", href = "favicon.svg")),

  nav_panel(
    "Wet and dry days",
    layout_sidebar(
      fillable = FALSE,
      sidebar = sidebar(
        width = 230, class = "picker",
        open = list(desktop = "open", mobile = "always-above"),
        radioButtons("months", "Months", names(MONTHS)),
        radioButtons("decade", "Decade", c("All years", DECADES)),
        p(class = "side-note", "Nungambakkam (IMD). A day is wet with 2.5 mm of rain or more.")
      ),
      page_head("How rain follows rain", "lede_main"),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, lg = c(5, 7)),
        card(card_header("Transition probabilities"), uiOutput("matrix")),
        card(card_header("What the chain says"), uiOutput("chain_facts"))
      ),
      card(
        card_header("Spell lengths: real seasons against the chain"),
        div(class = "legend",
            span(class = "li", span(class = "key key-dot wet"), span(class = "key key-dot dry"), "Observed"),
            legend_item("key-line", "Chain, with its 90% range")),
        layout_columns(
          col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, md = c(6, 6)),
          girafeOutput("spell_wet"), girafeOutput("spell_dry")
        ),
        uiOutput("spell_verdict")
      ),
      card(
        card_header(class = "with-action", span("One season, real and simulated"),
                    actionButton("resim", "Simulate another", class = "btn-sm btn-primary")),
        girafeOutput("season_plot"),
        uiOutput("season_caption")
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "Decades",
    div(class = "page",
        page_head("Has the monsoon changed?", "lede_decades"),
        card(card_header("Rain in each season"), girafeOutput("season_totals"),
             caption("October to December totals at Nungambakkam. Grey seasons have a missing month and are not used.")),
        layout_columns(
          col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, lg = c(6, 6)),
          card(card_header("Persistence by decade (H4)"), girafeOutput("decade_chain"),
               uiOutput("h4_text")),
          card(card_header("Heavy-rain days by decade (H5)"), girafeOutput("heavy_share"),
               uiOutput("h5_text"))
        )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "Extremes",
    div(class = "page",
        page_head("How heavy can one day get?", "lede_extremes"),
        card(
          card_header(class = "with-action", span("Which distribution fits"),
                      radioButtons("fit", NULL, fit_choices, selected = fits$best_aic, inline = TRUE)),
          layout_columns(
            col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, lg = c(5, 7)),
            div(uiOutput("fit_table"),
                caption("Fitted to the amounts of all wet days (2.5 mm or more), October to December, with the 2.5 mm cut-off built into the likelihood.")),
            div(uiOutput("qq_legend"), girafeOutput("qq_plot"),
                caption("Upper half of the wet days. On the dashed line, fitted and observed amounts agree."))
          )
        ),
        card(
          card_header("Return periods"),
          layout_columns(
            col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, lg = c(8, 4)),
            girafeOutput("return_plot"),
            uiOutput("return_table")
          ),
          caption("T(x) is about 1 / (λ [1 − F(x)]) years, where λ is the mean number of wet days per season. Ranges come from resampling whole seasons 400 times.")
        )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "Decision",
    div(class = "page",
        page_head("When should a flood alert go out?", "lede_decision"),
        layout_columns(
          col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, lg = c(7, 5)),
          card(card_header("Flood alert by the last two days"), girafeOutput("alert_plot"),
               uiOutput("alert_caption")),
          card(card_header("The alert rule"),
               sliderInput("cl", "Cost-loss ratio C/L", min = 0.002, max = 0.06,
                           value = 0.02, step = 0.001, ticks = FALSE, width = "100%"),
               p(class = "side-note", "C is the cost of acting on an alert. L is the loss when heavy rain arrives without one. Alert when the chance of heavy rain is above C/L."),
               uiOutput("alert_rule"))
        ),
        layout_columns(
          col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, lg = c(7, 5)),
          card(card_header("Dry-spell buffer for a reservoir"), girafeOutput("buffer_plot"),
               caption(sprintf("Longest run of dry days in a season. Grey line: 20,000 seasons simulated from the chain. Orange steps: the %d real seasons.", n_used))),
          card(card_header("Buffer days"),
               sliderInput("risk", "Accepted risk of a longer dry spell", min = 0.01,
                           max = 0.5, value = 0.1, step = 0.01, ticks = FALSE, width = "100%"),
               uiOutput("buffer_rule"))
        )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "Data",
    div(class = "page",
        page_head("Where the numbers come from", lede = paste(
          "Daily rain at Nungambakkam from the OpenCity Chennai rainfall dataset",
          "(state gauge records credited to TNDMA, dataset credited to IMD).",
          "The file lists rainy days only, so every gap was checked before any modelling.")),
        card(card_header(class = "with-action", span("Rules fixed before modelling"),
                         downloadButton("download", "Download the clean data",
                                        class = "btn-sm btn-outline-primary")),
             uiOutput("audit_rules")),
        card(card_header("Every October to December day"),
             div(class = "legend",
                 legend_item("key-sq wet", "Wet"),
                 legend_item("key-sq light", "Light rain, under 2.5 mm"),
                 legend_item("key-sq dry", "Dry"),
                 legend_item("key-sq missing", "Missing")),
             girafeOutput("calendar")),
        card(card_header("What the audit found"), uiOutput("audit_found"))
    )
  ),

  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(span(class = "nav-meta", "Nungambakkam · 1991 to 2023"))
)

# Server ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Each chart is drawn at the width of its box; phones get a slightly shorter chart
  draw <- function(id, plot, height, phone_height = height) {
    w <- session$clientData[[paste0("output_", id, "_width")]]
    if (is.null(w) || w < 100) w <- 700
    as_girafe(plot, w, if (w < 560) phone_height else height)
  }

  # Wet and dry days -----------------------------------------------------------------
  sel    <- reactive(select_days(days, MONTHS[[input$months]], input$decade))
  chain  <- reactive(fit_chain(sel()))
  h1     <- reactive(test_h1(chain()))
  h2     <- reactive(test_h2(sel()))
  spells <- reactive(pre$spells[[spell_key(input$months, input$decade)]])
  n_sel  <- reactive(length(unique(sel()$season)))

  output$lede_main <- renderUI({
    ch <- chain()
    years <- if (input$decade == "All years") "1991 to 2023" else input$decade
    p(sprintf("%s, %s (%s). After a wet day the next day is wet %s of the time; after a dry day, %s.",
              months_label(input$months), years, plural(n_sel(), "season"),
              pct(ch$p11[["est"]]), pct(ch$p01[["est"]])))
  })

  output$matrix <- renderUI({
    ch <- chain()
    tile <- function(est, lo, hi, state) {
      div(class = paste("tile", state), style = sprintf("--a:%.3f", est),
          div(class = "tile-p", num(est)),
          div(class = "tile-ci", paste(num(lo), "to", num(hi))))
    }
    a <- ch$p01
    b <- ch$p11
    tagList(
      div(class = "matrix",
          div(), div(class = "m-head", "Dry today"), div(class = "m-head", "Wet today"),
          div(class = "m-row", "Dry yesterday"),
          tile(1 - a[["est"]], 1 - a[["hi"]], 1 - a[["lo"]], "dry"),
          tile(a[["est"]], a[["lo"]], a[["hi"]], "wet"),
          div(class = "m-row", "Wet yesterday"),
          tile(1 - b[["est"]], 1 - b[["hi"]], 1 - b[["lo"]], "dry"),
          tile(b[["est"]], b[["lo"]], b[["hi"]], "wet")),
      caption(sprintf("From %s pairs of days with data. Ranges are 95%% intervals. Wet: 2.5 mm or more.",
                      num(ch$n_pairs, 0)))
    )
  })

  output$chain_facts <- renderUI({
    ch <- chain()
    t1 <- h1()
    t2 <- h2()
    small <- if (min(t2$min_expected, t1$min_expected) < 5) "Some expected counts are under 5: read with care." else NULL
    pw <- t2$p_wet
    h2_answer <- if (t2$p < 0.05) {
      sprintf("No. The day before yesterday still matters: after two dry days rain follows %s of the time, after a wet day and then a dry one %s.",
              pct(pw[["DD"]]), pct(pw[["WD"]]))
    } else {
      "Yes. Knowing the day before yesterday does not change the odds in a way the data can detect."
    }
    tagList(
      div(class = "facts",
          fact_item(pct(ch$pi_wet), "of days wet in the long run"),
          fact_item(paste(num(ch$mean_wet_spell, 1), "days"), "typical wet spell"),
          fact_item(paste(num(ch$mean_dry_spell, 1), "days"), "typical dry spell")),
      test_block("H1", "Does today depend on yesterday?",
                 if (t1$p < 0.05) sprintf("Yes. A wet yesterday raises the chance of rain today by %s points.", num(100 * t1$diff, 0))
                 else "Not detectably in this selection.",
                 chi_text(t1$stat, t1$df, t1$p)),
      test_block("H2", "Is one day of memory enough?", h2_answer,
                 chi_text(t2$stat, t2$df, t2$p), small)
    )
  })

  output$spell_wet <- renderGirafe(draw("spell_wet", plot_spells(spells()$wet, "wet"), 300, 260))
  output$spell_dry <- renderGirafe(draw("spell_dry", plot_spells(spells()$dry, "dry"), 300, 260))

  output$spell_verdict <- renderUI({
    s <- spells()
    line <- function(r, state) {
      name <- tools::toTitleCase(state)
      head <- if (r$p_mc >= 0.05) {
        sprintf("%s spells match the chain (Monte Carlo %s).", name, p_text(r$p_mc))
      } else {
        sprintf("%s spells do not match the chain (Monte Carlo %s): real seasons have %s %s spells of %s than it expects (%s against %s).",
                name, p_text(r$p_mc), if (r$worst_obs > r$worst_exp) "more" else "fewer", state,
                r$worst_bin, pct(r$worst_obs), pct(r$worst_exp))
      }
      tail <- sprintf("Spells of %d days or more: %s observed, %s simulated (90%% range %s to %s).",
                      r$long, pct(r$long_obs, 1), pct(r$long_sim, 1), pct(r$long_band[1], 1),
                      pct(r$long_band[2], 1))
      div(class = "verdict", span(class = paste("key key-dot", state)), span(head, tail))
    }
    tagList(
      line(s$wet, "wet"), line(s$dry, "dry"),
      caption(sprintf("H3. %s simulated records of %s each, against the %s real ones. Spells touching a missing day are left out.",
                      num(s$n_sets, 0), plural(s$n_seasons, "season"), num(s$n_seasons, 0)))
    )
  })

  one_season <- eventReactive(list(input$resim, sel()), {
    d  <- sel()
    ch <- chain()
    pick <- sample(unique(d$season), 1)
    obs <- d[d$season == pick, c("date", "dos", "rain_mm")]
    obs$rain_mm[is.na(obs$rain_mm)] <- 0
    dos <- sort(unique(d$dos))
    wet <- simulate_states(ch$p01[["est"]], ch$p11[["est"]], length(dos), 1, ch$pi_wet)[1, ]
    sim <- data.frame(date = as.Date("2001-10-01") + dos - 1, dos = dos, rain_mm = 0)
    sim$rain_mm[wet] <- round(r_amount(sum(wet), best_fit), 1)
    list(obs = obs, sim = sim, year = pick)
  })

  output$season_plot <- renderGirafe({
    s <- one_season()
    draw("season_plot", plot_season(s$obs, s$sim, paste0(s$year, ", observed")), 330, 300)
  })

  output$season_caption <- renderUI({
    s <- one_season()
    caption(sprintf("The real season is drawn at random from your selection. Simulated wet days take their amounts from the %s fit on the Extremes page. %d wet days observed, %d simulated.",
                    DIST_NAMES[[fits$best_aic]], sum(s$obs$rain_mm >= WET_MM), sum(s$sim$rain_mm >= WET_MM)))
  })

  # Decades ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  output$lede_decades <- renderUI({
    p(sprintf("Across the three decades the chain shows no clear change (%s), and neither does the share of heavy-rain days (%s). With about 900 days per decade, only large shifts would show.",
              p_text(h4$p), p_text(h5$p)))
  })
  output$season_totals <- renderGirafe(draw("season_totals", plot_season_totals(audit$seasons), 300, 260))
  output$decade_chain  <- renderGirafe(draw("decade_chain", plot_decade_chain(h4$per_decade), 300, 270))
  output$heavy_share   <- renderGirafe(draw("heavy_share", plot_heavy_share(h5), 300, 270))

  output$h4_text <- renderUI({
    tagList(
      test_block("H4", "Has the chain changed across decades?",
                 if (h4$p < 0.05) "Yes, the transition counts differ between decades." else "No clear change. The intervals overlap in every decade.",
                 chi_text(h4$stat, h4$df, h4$p),
                 sprintf("From a dry day %s; from a wet day %s.", p_text(h4$from_dry$p), p_text(h4$from_wet$p))),
      caption("Chi-square test of homogeneity on the transition counts, October to December. Bars are 95% intervals.")
    )
  })

  output$h5_text <- renderUI({
    tagList(
      test_block("H5", "Has the heavy tail changed?",
                 if (h5$p < 0.05) "Yes, the share of heavy days differs between decades."
                 else sprintf("No clear change in days above %s mm, the full-record 95th percentile of wet days.", num(h5$q95, 0)),
                 chi_text(h5$stat, h5$df, h5$p),
                 sprintf("ANOVA on log wet-day amounts: F = %s, %s.", num(h5$anova_f, 2), p_text(h5$anova_p))),
      caption("Wet days only (2.5 mm or more). Bars are 95% intervals.")
    )
  })

  # Extremes ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  returns <- reactive(get_returns(input$fit))

  output$lede_extremes <- renderUI({
    r <- get_returns(fits$best_aic)
    r10 <- r[which.min(abs(r$T - 10)), ]
    top <- ond[which.max(ond$rain_mm), ]
    p(sprintf("A 10-year day at Nungambakkam brings about %s mm of rain (%s fit, 90%% range %s to %s mm). The wettest day in the record gave %s mm, on %s.",
              num(r10$level, 0), DIST_NAMES[[fits$best_aic]], num(r10$lo, 0), num(r10$hi, 0),
              num(top$rain_mm, 1), fmt_date(top$date)))
  })

  output$fit_table <- renderUI({
    t <- fits$table
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(t)), function(i) {
      tags$tr(class = if (t$dist[i] == input$fit) "best" else NULL,
              tags$td(t$name[i], tags$div(class = "sub", t$params[i])),
              tags$td(num(t$aic[i], 0)),
              tags$td(if (t$delta_aic[i] < 0.05) "lowest" else paste0("+", num(t$delta_aic[i], 1))),
              tags$td(num(t$tail_error[i], 3)))
    })
    tagList(
      tags$table(class = "tbl",
                 tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Fit"), tags$th("AIC"), tags$th("ΔAIC"),
                                    tags$th("Tail error"))),
                 tags$tbody(rows)),
      p(class = "note", if (fits$best_aic == fits$best_tail) {
        sprintf("%s has the lowest AIC and also sits closest to the wettest 5%% of days (tail error: mean log distance between fitted and observed). %s wet days.",
                DIST_NAMES[[fits$best_aic]], num(fits$n, 0))
      } else {
        sprintf("%s has the lowest AIC, but %s sits closest to the wettest 5%% of days (tail error: mean log distance between fitted and observed). %s wet days.",
                DIST_NAMES[[fits$best_aic]], DIST_NAMES[[fits$best_tail]], num(fits$n, 0))
      })
    )
  })

  output$qq_legend <- renderUI({
    div(class = "legend",
        legend_item("key-dot wet", DIST_NAMES[[input$fit]]),
        legend_item("key-dot grey", paste(DIST_NAMES[names(DIST_NAMES) != input$fit], collapse = " and ")))
  })

  output$qq_plot <- renderGirafe(draw("qq_plot", plot_qq(fits, input$fit), 300, 280))

  output$return_plot <- renderGirafe({
    r <- returns()
    w <- ond[!is.na(ond$wet) & ond$wet, ]
    w <- w[order(-w$rain_mm), ][1:25, ]
    w$T <- record_years / seq_len(25)
    draw("return_plot", plot_returns(r, w, record_years, DIST_NAMES[[input$fit]]), 340, 300)
  })

  output$return_table <- renderUI({
    r <- returns()
    r <- r[r$T %in% RETURN_T, ]
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(r)), function(i) {
      tags$tr(class = if (r$T[i] > record_years) "extrap" else NULL,
              tags$td(paste(r$T[i], "years")),
              tags$td(paste(num(r$level[i], 0), "mm")),
              tags$td(paste(num(r$lo[i], 0), "to", num(r$hi[i], 0))))
    })
    tagList(
      tags$table(class = "tbl",
                 tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Every"), tags$th("One day of"), tags$th("90% range"))),
                 tags$tbody(rows)),
      p(class = "note", sprintf("%s fit. The record has %d usable seasons, so the 50 and 100-year rows are extrapolations that lean on the shape of the fitted tail.",
                                DIST_NAMES[[input$fit]], n_used))
    )
  })

  # Decision -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  output$lede_decision <- renderUI({
    lo <- which.min(alert_tab$p_heavy)
    hi <- which.max(alert_tab$p_heavy)
    p(sprintf("Heavy rain here means a day above %s mm, the wettest 5%% of wet days. The chance of one tomorrow runs from %s %s to %s %s.",
              num(h5$q95, 0), pct(alert_tab$p_heavy[lo], 1), alert_tab$after[lo],
              pct(alert_tab$p_heavy[hi], 1), alert_tab$after[hi]))
  })

  output$alert_plot <- renderGirafe(draw("alert_plot", plot_alert(alert_tab, input$cl), 300, 260))

  output$alert_caption <- renderUI({
    caption(sprintf("Bars: chance of a wet day from the chain%s, times the %s chance that a wet day passes %s mm (%s fit). Black ticks: how often it happened in the record. Line: C/L.",
                    if (use_second_order) " (second order, since H2 rejects first order)" else "",
                    pct(alert_tab$p_heavy_if_wet[1], 1), num(h5$q95, 0), DIST_NAMES[[fits$best_aic]]))
  })

  output$alert_rule <- renderUI({
    on <- alert_tab$p_heavy > input$cl
    rule <- if (!any(on)) {
      "At this ratio no state calls for an alert: acting costs too much for how rare heavy rain is."
    } else if (all(on)) {
      "At this ratio every state calls for an alert: acting is cheap next to the loss."
    } else {
      paste0("Issue an alert ", join_and(alert_tab$after[on]), ".")
    }
    thresholds <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(alert_tab)), function(i) {
      tags$tr(class = if (on[i]) "on" else NULL,
              tags$td(alert_tab$state[i]), tags$td(paste("C/L below", num(alert_tab$p_heavy[i], 3))))
    })
    tagList(
      p(class = "rule", rule),
      tags$table(class = "tbl compact", tags$tbody(thresholds)),
      p(class = "note", "C and L are assumptions, not measured costs. This is a framework, not a calibrated warning system.")
    )
  })

  buffer_k <- reactive(list(
    chain = buffer_days(dry_max$curve, "chain", input$risk),
    observed = buffer_days(dry_max$curve, "observed", input$risk)
  ))

  output$buffer_plot <- renderGirafe({
    draw("buffer_plot", plot_buffer(dry_max, input$risk, buffer_k()$chain), 300, 260)
  })

  output$buffer_rule <- renderUI({
    k <- buffer_k()
    dry_fit <- spells_all$dry$p_mc >= 0.05
    levels <- c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5)
    rows <- lapply(levels, function(r) {
      tags$tr(tags$td(paste(pct(r), "risk")),
              tags$td(plural(buffer_days(dry_max$curve, "chain", r), "day")),
              tags$td(plural(buffer_days(dry_max$curve, "observed", r), "day")))
    })
    tagList(
      p(class = "rule", sprintf("Hold %s of supply to keep the chance of a longer dry spell at or below %s in a season.",
                                plural(k$chain, "day"), pct(input$risk))),
      tags$table(class = "tbl compact",
                 tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Risk"), tags$th("Chain"), tags$th("Record"))),
                 tags$tbody(rows)),
      p(class = "note", sprintf("The %d real seasons alone give %s at your risk level. %s", n_used,
                                plural(k$observed, "day"),

# Loading the prepared data and choosing the days a view asks for.
# Shiny sources every file in R/ automatically, before app.R runs.

WET_MM <- 2.5   # IMD wet-day threshold: a day is wet with 2.5 mm or more

DECADES <- c("1991 to 2001", "2002 to 2012", "2013 to 2023")

MONTHS <- list(
  "Oct to Dec" = 10:12,
  "October"    = 10,
  "November"   = 11,
  "December"   = 12
)

decade_of <- function(season) {
  cut(season, breaks = c(1990, 2001, 2012, 2023), labels = DECADES)
}

# One row per October to December day. rain_mm is NA on missing days.
load_days <- function(dir = "data") {
  d <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "nungambakkam_ond.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  s <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "audit_seasons.csv"))
  d$date   <- as.Date(d$date)
  d        <- d[order(d$date), ]
  d$used   <- d$season %in% s$season[s$used]
  d$wet    <- d$rain_mm >= WET_MM
  d$decade <- decade_of(d$season)
  # Yesterday and the day before, inside the same season (NA on 1 and 2 October)
  lag_in_season <- function(x, k) ave(x, d$season, FUN = function(v) c(rep(NA, k), head(v, -k)))
  d$prev  <- lag_in_season(d$wet, 1)
  d$prev2 <- lag_in_season(d$wet, 2)
  d
}

load_audit <- function(dir = "data") {
  facts <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "audit_facts.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  list(
    seasons = read.csv(file.path(dir, "audit_seasons.csv")),
    facts   = setNames(as.list(facts$value), facts$key)
  )
}

# Results of the slow simulations, made by prepare/precompute.R

# Days of the used seasons, for some months and one decade (or all years)

  if (decade != "All years") keep <- keep & d$decade == decade

# The closing decision: a flood alert rule from the cost-loss model, and the
# alternative, reservoir buffer days for a chosen dry-spell risk.

# Chance of a heavy-rain day tomorrow for each current state:
# P(wet tomorrow | state) from the chain, times P(amount above the cut-off | wet)
# from the amount fit. Second-order states are used when H2 rejects first order.
alert_states <- function(days, chain, h2, fit, heavy_mm, second_order = FALSE) {
  p_heavy_if_wet <- wet_exceed(fit, heavy_mm)
  ok <- !is.na(days$wet) & !is.na(days$prev)
  heavy <- days$rain_mm > heavy_mm
  if (!second_order) {
    st <- data.frame(
      state = c("After a dry day", "After a wet day"),
      after = c("after a dry day", "after a wet day"),
      p_wet = c(chain$p01[["est"]], chain$p11[["est"]])
    )
    groups <- list(ok & !days$prev, ok & days$prev)
  } else {
    ok2 <- ok & !is.na(days$prev2)
    st <- data.frame(
      state = c("Two dry days", "Wet, then dry", "Dry, then wet", "Two wet days"),
      after = c("after two dry days", "after a wet day and then a dry one",
                "after a dry day and then a wet one", "after two wet days"),
      p_wet = unname(h2$p_wet[c("DD", "WD", "DW", "WW")])
    )
    groups <- list(ok2 & !days$prev2 & !days$prev, ok2 & days$prev2 & !days$prev,
                   ok2 & !days$prev2 & days$prev, ok2 & days$prev2 & days$prev)
  }
  st$p_heavy  <- st$p_wet * p_heavy_if_wet
  st$observed <- vapply(groups, function(g) mean(heavy[g]), numeric(1))
  st$n        <- vapply(groups, sum, numeric(1))
  st$p_heavy_if_wet <- p_heavy_if_wet
  st
}

# Longest dry spell in each season, observed and simulated from the chain
longest_dry <- function(days, chain, n_sim = 20000, seed = 5) {
  obs <- observed_spells(days)
  obs_max <- tapply(obs$length[!obs$wet], obs$block[!obs$wet], max)
  n_days <- length(unique(days$dos))
  sim <- withr::with_seed(seed, simulate_states(chain$p01[["est"]], chain$p11[["est"]],
                                                n_days, n_sim, chain$pi_wet))
  runs <- runs_of(as.vector(t(sim)), rep(seq_len(n_sim), each = n_days))
  sim_max <- tapply(runs$length[!runs$wet], runs$block[!runs$wet], max)
  sim_max <- c(sim_max, rep(0, n_sim - length(sim_max)))   # seasons with no dry day
  k <- 0:max(c(obs_max, sim_max))
  list(
    curve = data.frame(
      k        = k,
      chain    = vapply(k, function(i) mean(sim_max > i), numeric(1)),
      observed = vapply(k, function(i) mean(obs_max > i), numeric(1))
    ),
    obs_max = obs_max
  )
}

# Smallest k with P(longest dry spell > k) at or below the risk level
buffer_days <- function(curve, column, risk) {
  min(curve$k[curve[[column]] <= risk])
}

name: R/extremes.R
content:
# Wet-day amounts: lognormal, gamma and Weibull fits, return periods, and the
# heavy-rain comparison across decades (H5).
#
# Only amounts of 2.5 mm or more are ever wet-day amounts, so each distribution is
# fitted by maximum likelihood with that cut-off built in (a left-truncated fit).
# Parameters are estimated on the log scale where they must be positive.

DIST_NAMES <- c(gamma = "Gamma", lognormal = "Lognormal", weibull = "Weibull")

dist_fun <- function(dist) {
  switch(dist,
    lognormal = list(
      d = function(x, th, log = FALSE) dlnorm(x, th[1], exp(th[2]), log = log),
      p = function(x, th, ...) plnorm(x, th[1], exp(th[2]), ...),
      q = function(u, th, ...) qlnorm(u, th[1], exp(th[2]), ...),
      start = function(x) c(mean(log(x)), log(sd(log(x)))),
      show  = function(th) sprintf("meanlog %.2f, sdlog %.2f", th[1], exp(th[2]))
    ),
    gamma = list(
      d = function(x, th, log = FALSE) dgamma(x, shape = exp(th[1]), scale = exp(th[2]), log = log),
      p = function(x, th, ...) pgamma(x, shape = exp(th[1]), scale = exp(th[2]), ...),
      q = function(u, th, ...) qgamma(u, shape = exp(th[1]), scale = exp(th[2]), ...),
      start = function(x) c(log(mean(x)^2 / var(x)), log(var(x) / mean(x))),
      show  = function(th) sprintf("shape %.2f, scale %.1f mm", exp(th[1]), exp(th[2]))
    ),
    weibull = list(
      d = function(x, th, log = FALSE) dweibull(x, shape = exp(th[1]), scale = exp(th[2]), log = log),
      p = function(x, th, ...) pweibull(x, shape = exp(th[1]), scale = exp(th[2]), ...),
      q = function(u, th, ...) qweibull(u, shape = exp(th[1]), scale = exp(th[2]), ...),
      start = function(x) c(log(0.9), log(mean(x))),
      show  = function(th) sprintf("shape %.2f, scale %.1f mm", exp(th[1]), exp(th[2]))
    )
  )
}

fit_amounts <- function(x, dist, cut = WET_MM, start = NULL, reltol = 1e-12) {
  f <- dist_fun(dist)
  nll <- function(th) {
    ll <- sum(f$d(x, th, log = TRUE)) - length(x) * f$p(cut, th, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(ll)) return(1e10)
    -ll
  }
  o <- optim(if (is.null(start)) f$start(x) else start, nll,
             control = list(maxit = 5000, reltol = reltol))
  list(dist = dist, theta = o$par, loglik = -o$value, aic = 2 * o$value + 2 * length(o$par),
       n = length(x), cut = cut, converged = o$convergence == 0)
}

# P(amount > x) on a wet day
wet_exceed <- function(fit, x) {
  f <- dist_fun(fit$dist)
  f$p(x, fit$theta, lower.tail = FALSE) / f$p(fit$cut, fit$theta, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

# The wet-day amount exceeded with probability `tail` (worked from the upper tail)
wet_quantile_upper <- function(fit, tail) {
  f <- dist_fun(fit$dist)
  f$q(tail * f$p(fit$cut, fit$theta, lower.tail = FALSE), fit$theta, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

r_amount <- function(n, fit) wet_quantile_upper(fit, runif(n))

# lambda: expected wet days in a 92-day season, allowing for missing days
wet_rate <- function(days) {
  ok <- !is.na(days$wet)
  92 * mean(days$wet[ok])
}

# T(x) is about 1 / (lambda [1 - F(x)]) years, so the T-year daily amount is the
# wet-day amount exceeded with probability 1 / (lambda T)
return_level  <- function(fit, lambda, T) wet_quantile_upper(fit, 1 / (lambda * T))
return_period <- function(fit, lambda, x) 1 / (lambda * wet_exceed(fit, x))

wet_amounts <- function(days) days$rain_mm[!is.na(days$wet) & days$wet]

# All three fits, ranked by AIC, with a check of the upper tail: the average
# distance (on the log scale) between fitted and observed amounts in the top 5 percent.
compare_fits <- function(days) {
  x <- sort(wet_amounts(days))
  n <- length(x)
  pp <- (seq_len(n) - 0.5) / n
  fits <- lapply(names(DIST_NAMES), function(dn) fit_amounts(x, dn))
  names(fits) <- names(DIST_NAMES)
  top <- pp > 0.95
  qq <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, function(f) {
    data.frame(dist = f$dist, observed = x, fitted = wet_quantile_upper(f, 1 - pp), p = pp)
  }))
  table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, function(f) {
    fitted_top <- wet_quantile_upper(f, 1 - pp[top])
    data.frame(dist = f$dist, name = DIST_NAMES[[f$dist]],
               params = dist_fun(f$dist)$show(f$theta),
               loglik = f$loglik, aic = f$aic,
               tail_error = mean(abs(log(fitted_top / x[top]))))
  }))
  table$delta_aic <- table$aic - min(table$aic)
  table <- table[order(table$aic), ]
  list(fits = fits, table = table, qq = qq, n = n,
       best_aic = table$dist[1], best_tail = table$dist[which.min(table$tail_error)])
}

# Return levels with intervals from resampling whole seasons (keeps the
# dependence between days of the same season). T_GRID draws the curve.
RETURN_T <- c(2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100)
T_GRID   <- sort(unique(c(exp(seq(log(1.2), log(200), length.out = 40)), RETURN_T)))

bootstrap_returns <- function(days, dist, T = RETURN_T, B = 400, seed = 11) {
  by_season <- split(days, days$season)
  amounts <- lapply(by_season, wet_amounts)
  wet_n <- vapply(by_season, function(s) sum(s$wet, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  ok_n  <- vapply(by_season, function(s) sum(!is.na(s$wet)), numeric(1))
  full  <- fit_amounts(unlist(amounts), dist)
  n <- length(by_season)
  levels <- matrix(NA_real_, B, length(T))
  withr::with_seed(seed, {
    for (b in seq_len(B)) {
      pick <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
      fit  <- fit_amounts(unlist(amounts[pick]), dist, start = full$theta, reltol = 1e-8)
      lam  <- 92 * sum(wet_n[pick]) / sum(ok_n[pick])
      levels[b, ] <- return_level(fit, lam, T)
    }
  })
  lambda <- wet_rate(days)
  data.frame(
    T     = T,
    level = return_level(full, lambda, T),
    lo    = apply(levels, 2, quantile, 0.05),
    hi    = apply(levels, 2, quantile, 0.95)
  )
}

# H5: has the extreme tail changed? Share of wet days above the full-record 95th
# percentile by decade (chi-square), and ANOVA on log wet-day amounts.
test_h5 <- function(days) {
  w <- days[!is.na(days$wet) & days$wet, ]
  w$decade <- droplevels(w$decade)
  q95   <- unname(quantile(w$rain_mm, 0.95))
  heavy <- w$rain_mm > q95
  tb <- table(w$decade, heavy)
  ct <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tb, correct = FALSE))
  share <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(w$decade), function(dc) {
    s <- wilson(sum(heavy[w$decade == dc]), sum(w$decade == dc))
    data.frame(decade = dc, share = s[["est"]], lo = s[["lo"]], hi = s[["hi"]],
               heavy = sum(heavy[w$decade == dc]), wet = sum(w$decade == dc),
               geo_mean = exp(mean(log(w$rain_mm[w$decade == dc]))))
  }))
  av <- summary(aov(log(rain_mm) ~ decade, data = w))[[1]]
  list(q95 = q95, share = share, stat = unname(ct$statistic), df = unname(ct$parameter),
       p = ct$p.value, anova_f = av[["F value"]][1], anova_df = av[["Df"]],
       anova_p = av[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
}

name: R/markov.R
content:
# Two-state Markov chain for wet (W) and dry (D) days: fit, tests and simulation.

# Wilson score interval for a proportion x / n
wilson <- function(x, n, level = 0.95) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(est = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_))
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - level) / 2)
  p <- x / n
  centre <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  half   <- z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  c(est = p, lo = centre - half, hi = centre + half)
}

state_factor <- function(x) factor(x, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Dry", "Wet"))

# Yesterday by today counts. Pairs that include a missing day are left out.
transition_counts <- function(days) {
  ok <- !is.na(days$wet) & !is.na(days$prev)
  table(yesterday = state_factor(days$prev[ok]), today = state_factor(days$wet[ok]))
}

fit_chain <- function(days) {
  n   <- transition_counts(days)
  p01 <- wilson(n["Dry", "Wet"], sum(n["Dry", ]))   # P(wet today | dry yesterday)
  p11 <- wilson(n["Wet", "Wet"], sum(n["Wet", ]))   # P(wet today | wet yesterday)
  a <- p01[["est"]]
  b <- p11[["est"]]
  list(
    counts         = n,
    p01            = p01,
    p11            = p11,
    pi_wet         = a / (a + 1 - b),   # long-run share of wet days (steady state)
    mean_wet_spell = 1 / (1 - b),
    mean_dry_spell = 1 / a,
    n_pairs        = sum(n)
  )
}

# H1: does today depend on yesterday? Chi-square test of independence, 2 by 2 table.
test_h1 <- function(chain) {
  ct <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(chain$counts, correct = FALSE))
  list(
    stat         = unname(ct$statistic),
    df           = 1L,
    p            = ct$p.value,
    min_expected = min(ct$expected),
    diff         = chain$p11[["est"]] - chain$p01[["est"]]
  )
}

# H2: is first order enough? The last two days (DD, WD, DW, WW) against today.
# Histories are compared only within the same yesterday state: DD with WD
# (yesterday dry) and DW with WW (yesterday wet), one degree of freedom each.
# History "WD" means wet the day before yesterday, dry yesterday.
test_h2 <- function(days) {
  ok <- !is.na(days$wet) & !is.na(days$prev) & !is.na(days$prev2)
  d  <- days[ok, ]
  history <- paste0(ifelse(d$prev2, "W", "D"), ifelse(d$prev, "W", "D"))
  tab <- table(history = factor(history, c("DD", "WD", "DW", "WW")), today = state_factor(d$wet))
  part <- function(rows) {
    t <- tab[rows, ]
    if (any(rowSums(t) == 0) || any(colSums(t) == 0)) return(c(stat = 0, min_e = NA))
    ct <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(t, correct = FALSE))
    c(stat = unname(ct$statistic), min_e = min(ct$expected))
  }
  dry_yesterday <- part(c("DD", "WD"))
  wet_yesterday <- part(c("DW", "WW"))
  stat <- dry_yesterday[["stat"]] + wet_yesterday[["stat"]]
  list(
    stat         = stat,
    df           = 2L,
    p            = pchisq(stat, 2, lower.tail = FALSE),
    min_expected = suppressWarnings(min(dry_yesterday[["min_e"]], wet_yesterday[["min_e"]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    table        = tab,
    p_wet        = tab[, "Wet"] / rowSums(tab),
    n            = rowSums(tab)
  )
}

# H4: has the chain changed across decades? Homogeneity of the transition counts:
# one decade by today table for each yesterday state, 2 degrees of freedom each.
test_h4 <- function(days) {
  ok <- !is.na(days$wet) & !is.na(days$prev)
  d  <- days[ok, ]
  d$decade <- droplevels(d$decade)
  part <- function(yesterday_wet) {
    s  <- d[d$prev == yesterday_wet, ]
    tb <- table(s$decade, state_factor(s$wet))
    ct <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tb, correct = FALSE))
    list(stat = unname(ct$statistic), df = unname(ct$parameter), p = ct$p.value, table = tb)
  }
  from_dry <- part(FALSE)
  from_wet <- part(TRUE)
  per_decade <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(d$decade), function(dc) {
    a <- from_dry$table[dc, ]
    b <- from_wet$table[dc, ]
    p01 <- wilson(a[["Wet"]], sum(a))
    p11 <- wilson(b[["Wet"]], sum(b))
    data.frame(decade = dc,
               p01 = p01[["est"]], p01_lo = p01[["lo"]], p01_hi = p01[["hi"]],
               p11 = p11[["est"]], p11_lo = p11[["lo"]], p11_hi = p11[["hi"]])
  }))
  stat <- from_dry$stat + from_wet$stat
  df   <- from_dry$df + from_wet$df
  list(stat = stat, df = df, p = pchisq(stat, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
       from_dry = from_dry, from_wet = from_wet, per_decade = per_decade)
}

# Runs of wet or dry days. `code` is TRUE (wet), FALSE (dry) or NA (missing) and
# `block` marks the season, so a run never crosses into the next season. A run that
# touches a missing day is dropped, because its true length is unknown. Runs cut by
# the start or end of the period are kept, in the observed and simulated data alike.
runs_of <- function(code, block) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(code), 2L, as.integer(code))
  n <- length(x)
  start <- c(TRUE, x[-1] != x[-n] | block[-1] != block[-n])
  len <- tabulate(cumsum(start))
  val <- x[start]
  blk <- block[start]
  m <- length(val)
  same_next <- c(blk[-1] == blk[-m], FALSE)
  same_prev <- c(FALSE, blk[-1] == blk[-m])
  next_missing <- c(val[-1] == 2L, FALSE) & same_next
  prev_missing <- c(FALSE, val[-m] == 2L) & same_prev
  keep <- val != 2L & !next_missing & !prev_missing
  data.frame(wet = val[keep] == 1L, length = len[keep], block = blk[keep])
}

observed_spells <- function(days) {
  days <- days[order(days$season, days$dos), ]
  runs_of(days$wet, days$season)
}

# Simulated wet (TRUE) and dry (FALSE) days: one row per season, one column per day
simulate_states <- function(p01, p11, n_days, n_seasons, p_start) {
  s <- matrix(FALSE, n_seasons, n_days)
  s[, 1] <- runif(n_seasons) < p_start
  for (t in seq_len(n_days)[-1]) {
    s[, t] <- runif(n_seasons) < ifelse(s[, t - 1], p11, p01)
  }
  s
}

# Bins for the goodness-of-fit statistic: wet spells 1, 2, 3, 4, 5+ days and
# dry spells 1, 2, 3-4, 5-7, 8-14, 15+ days. Long spells are 5+ wet or 15+ dry.
SPELL_BINS <- list(wet = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), dry = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 15))
SPELL_BIN_NAMES <- list(
  wet = c("1 day", "2 days", "3 days", "4 days", "5 days or more"),
  dry = c("1 day", "2 days", "3 to 4 days", "5 to 7 days", "8 to 14 days", "15 days or more")
)
LONG_SPELL <- c(wet = 5, dry = 15)

# H3: does the fitted chain reproduce the observed spells? The chain simulates
# n_sets records, each with as many seasons as the observed record. The spread of
# those records gives a 90 percent range for every spell length, and a Monte Carlo
# p-value for a chi-square distance between observed and expected spell lengths.
compare_spells <- function(days, chain, n_sets = 1000, seed = 2026) {
  obs <- observed_spells(days)
  n_seasons <- length(unique(days$season))
  n_days    <- length(unique(days$dos))
  # a fixed seed keeps results stable, without resetting the session's own random numbers
  sim <- withr::with_seed(seed, simulate_states(chain$p01[["est"]], chain$p11[["est"]],
                                                n_days, n_seasons * n_sets, chain$pi_wet))
  runs <- runs_of(as.vector(t(sim)), rep(seq_len(n_seasons * n_sets), each = n_days))
  runs$set <- (runs$block - 1L) %/% n_seasons + 1L

  one_state <- function(state) {
    is_wet  <- state == "wet"
    o_len   <- obs$length[obs$wet == is_wet]
    s       <- runs[runs$wet == is_wet, ]
    k_max   <- min(n_days, max(c(o_len, quantile(s$length, 0.999))))
    # spells of each length (capped at k_max) in every simulated record
    idx     <- (s$set - 1L) * k_max + pmin(s$length, k_max)
    counts  <- matrix(tabulate(idx, nbins = n_sets * k_max), nrow = n_sets, byrow = TRUE)
    at_least <- t(apply(counts, 1, function(r) rev(cumsum(rev(r))))) / rowSums(counts)
    band    <- apply(at_least, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)
    k       <- seq_len(k_max)
    curve <- data.frame(
      k        = k,
      observed = vapply(k, function(i) mean(o_len >= i), numeric(1)),
      n_obs    = vapply(k, function(i) sum(o_len >= i), numeric(1)),
      chain    = vapply(k, function(i) mean(s$length >= i), numeric(1)),
      lo       = band[1, ],
      hi       = band[2, ]
    )
    # Monte Carlo goodness of fit on binned spell lengths
    breaks   <- SPELL_BINS[[state]]
    nb       <- length(breaks)
    bin_of   <- function(len) findInterval(len, breaks)
    expected <- tabulate(bin_of(s$length), nbins = nb) / nrow(s)
    x2 <- function(o) {
      e <- sum(o) * expected
      sum((o - e)^2 / e)
    }
    o_bins  <- tabulate(bin_of(o_len), nbins = nb)
    x2_obs  <- x2(o_bins)
    sim_bins <- matrix(tabulate((s$set - 1L) * nb + bin_of(s$length), nbins = n_sets * nb),
                       nrow = n_sets, byrow = TRUE)
    x2_sim  <- apply(sim_bins, 1, x2)
    # the spell-length bin that contributes most to the distance
    e_bins  <- sum(o_bins) * expected
    worst   <- which.max((o_bins - e_bins)^2 / e_bins)
    long    <- LONG_SPELL[[state]]
    long_sets <- if (long <= k_max) at_least[, long] else rep(0, n_sets)
    list(
      curve     = curve,
      n_spells  = length(o_len),
      x2        = x2_obs,
      p_mc      = mean(x2_sim >= x2_obs),
      long      = long,
      long_obs  = mean(o_len >= long),
      long_n    = sum(o_len >= long),
      long_sim  = mean(s$length >= long),
      long_band = quantile(long_sets, c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
      longest_obs = max(o_len),
      worst_bin = SPELL_BIN_NAMES[[state]][worst],
      worst_obs = o_bins[worst] / sum(o_bins),
      worst_exp = expected[worst]
    )
  }
  list(wet = one_state("wet"), dry = one_state("dry"),
       n_seasons = n_seasons, n_days = n_days, n_sets = n_sets)
}

# Chart style and the charts. Charts are ggplot2 drawn as interactive SVG by # ggiraph, so every mark has a hover note. INK <- "#0b0b0b" INK_2 <- "#52514e" MUTED <- "#898781" GRID <- "#ebeae4" AXIS <- "#c3c2b7" WET <- "#2a78d6" WET_LT <- "#b7d3f6" DRY <- "#eb6834" DRY_LT <- "#f0efec" MISSING <- "#a9a79f" FONT <- "DM Sans" register_chart_font <- function(dir = "www/fonts") { systemfonts::register_font( name = FONT, plain = file.path(dir, "DMSans-400.ttf"), bold = file.path(dir, "DMSans-600.ttf") ) } # Number formatting; `d` (decimal places) may differ from value to value num <- function(x, d = 2) { d <- rep_len(d, length(x)) vapply(seq_along(x), function(i) { if (is.na(x[i])) return(NA_character_) formatC(x[i], format = "f", digits = d[i], big.mark = ",") }, character(1)) } pct <- function(x, d = 0) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, paste0(num(100 * x, d), "%")) fmt_date <- function(x, with_year = TRUE) { paste(as.integer(format(x, "%d")), format(x, if (with_year) "%b %Y" else "%b")) } theme_monsoon <- function(base_size = 10.5) { theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = FONT) + theme( panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.35), axis.text = element_text(colour = MUTED, size = rel(0.85)), axis.title = element_text(colour = INK_2, size = rel(0.85)), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6)), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(colour = INK_2, hjust = 0, size = rel(0.9), margin = margin(b = 4)), plot.margin = margin(6, 10, 4, 4) ) } # Charts are drawn at the pixel size of their box (96 px to the inch), so text # keeps the same size on a phone and on a wide screen. as_girafe <- function(p, width_px = 700, height_px = 320) { girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = width_px / 96, height_svg = height_px / 96, fonts = list(sans = FONT), options = list( opts_tooltip( css = paste0("background:", INK, ";color:#fff;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;", "font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;"), opacity = 0.96, offx = 14, offy = 14, use_fill = FALSE ), opts_hover(css = "opacity:1;"), opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"), opts_selection(type = "none"), opts_toolbar(saveaspng = FALSE, hidden = c("selection", "zoom", "misc")), opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE, width = 1) ) ) } # Spell lengths: share of spells lasting at least k days, observed against the chain plot_spells <- function(res, state) { col <- if (state == "wet") WET else DRY d <- res$curve floor_y <- 0.001 d <- d[d$chain >= floor_y | d$observed > 0, ] d$lo <- pmax(d$lo, floor_y) d$hi <- pmax(d$hi, floor_y) d$tip <- sprintf( "%d %s days or longer
Observed: %s of spells (%d)
Chain: %s, 90%% range %s to %s", d$k, state, pct(d$observed, 1), as.integer(d$n_obs), pct(d$chain, 1), pct(d$lo, 1), pct(d$hi, 1) ) pts <- d[d$observed > 0, ] ggplot(d, aes(k)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = INK, alpha = 0.07) + geom_line(aes(y = chain), colour = INK_2, linewidth = 0.55) + geom_point_interactive(data = pts, aes(y = observed, tooltip = tip, data_id = k), colour = col, size = 2.3) + scale_y_log10(labels = function(b) pct(b, ifelse(b < 0.01, 1, 0)), breaks = c(1, 0.3, 0.1, 0.03, 0.01, 0.003, 0.001)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(l) unique(round(pretty(l, 6)))) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(floor_y, 1)) + labs(x = sprintf("%s spell length, days or longer", tools::toTitleCase(state)), y = "Share of spells (log scale)") + theme_monsoon() } # One real season next to one season simulated from the chain plot_season <- function(obs, sim, obs_label) { obs$panel <- obs_label sim$panel <- "Simulated from the chain" d <- rbind(obs, sim) d$panel <- factor(d$panel, c(obs_label, "Simulated from the chain")) d$kind <- ifelse(d$rain_mm >= WET_MM, "wet", "light") d <- d[d$rain_mm > 0, ] d$tip <- sprintf("%s
%s mm%s", fmt_date(d$date, FALSE), num(d$rain_mm, 1), ifelse(d$kind == "light", " (dry day: under 2.5 mm)", "")) month_starts <- c("1 Oct" = 1, "1 Nov" = 32, "1 Dec" = 62) ggplot(d, aes(dos, rain_mm)) + geom_col_interactive(aes(fill = kind, tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(panel, dos)), width = 0.72) + facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(wet = WET, light = WET_LT)) + scale_y_sqrt(breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 200, 300), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_starts, labels = names(month_starts), limits = range(c(obs$dos, sim$dos)) + c(-0.6, 0.6), expand = expansion(0)) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Rain, mm (square-root scale)") + theme_monsoon() + theme(panel.spacing.y = unit(10, "pt")) } # Rainfall in each October to December season plot_season_totals <- function(seasons) { s <- seasons s$decade <- decade_of(s$season) s$tip <- ifelse( s$used, sprintf("%d
%s mm, %d wet days
ERA5 agrees on %s of days", s$season, num(s$total_mm, 0), s$wet_days, pct(s$agree_share)), sprintf("%d
Not used: %d days missing", s$season, s$missing_days) ) ggplot(s, aes(season, total_mm)) + geom_col_interactive(aes(fill = used, tooltip = tip, data_id = season), width = 0.72) + geom_vline(xintercept = c(2001.5, 2012.5), colour = AXIS, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "22") + annotate("text", x = c(1996, 2007, 2018), y = max(s$total_mm) * 1.07, label = DECADES, family = FONT, colour = MUTED, size = 3.1) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = WET, `FALSE` = MISSING)) + scale_y_continuous(labels = function(b) num(b, 0), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1991, 2023, 4), expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Rain, Oct to Dec (mm)") + theme_monsoon() } # p(wet after wet) and p(wet after dry) by decade, with 95% intervals plot_decade_chain <- function(per_decade) { d <- rbind( data.frame(decade = per_decade$decade, what = "Wet after wet", est = per_decade$p11, lo = per_decade$p11_lo, hi = per_decade$p11_hi), data.frame(decade = per_decade$decade, what = "Wet after dry", est = per_decade$p01, lo = per_decade$p01_lo, hi = per_decade$p01_hi) ) d$decade <- factor(d$decade, DECADES) d$tip <- sprintf("%s, %s
%s (95%% interval %s to %s)", d$what, d$decade, num(d$est), num(d$lo), num(d$hi)) lab <- d[d$decade == DECADES[3], ] ggplot(d, aes(decade, est, colour = what)) + geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.35) + geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(what, decade)), size = 2.8) + geom_text(data = lab, aes(label = what), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.14, family = FONT, size = 3.2) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("Wet after wet" = WET, "Wet after dry" = DRY)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.8), breaks = seq(0, 0.8, 0.2)) + scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 1.25))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Probability") + theme_monsoon() } # Share of wet days above the full-record 95th percentile, by decade plot_heavy_share <- function(h5) { d <- h5$share d$decade <- factor(d$decade, DECADES) d$tip <- sprintf("%s
%d of %d wet days above %s mm
%s (95%% interval %s to %s)", d$decade, d$heavy, d$wet, num(h5$q95, 0), pct(d$share, 1), pct(d$lo, 1), pct(d$hi, 1)) ggplot(d, aes(decade, share)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, colour = AXIS, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "22") + geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), colour = WET, linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.35) + geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = decade), colour = WET, size = 2.8) + annotate("text", x = 3.45, y = 0.05, label = "5% overall", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.6, family = FONT, colour = MUTED, size = 3) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.12), breaks = seq(0, 0.12, 0.02), labels = function(b) pct(b)) + scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 1.1))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Wet days that were heavy") + theme_monsoon() } # Upper half of the QQ plot for the three fits, chosen fit highlighted plot_qq <- function(fits, chosen) { d <- fits$qq[fits$qq$p > 0.5, ] d$name <- DIST_NAMES[d$dist] d$chosen <- d$dist == chosen d$tip <- sprintf("%s
Observed %s mm
Fit says %s mm", d$name, num(d$observed, 1), num(d$fitted, 1)) d <- d[order(d$chosen), ] ggplot(d, aes(fitted, observed)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = AXIS, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "22") + geom_point_interactive(aes(colour = chosen, size = chosen, tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(dist, p))) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = WET, `FALSE` = "#bdbcb5")) + scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.6, `FALSE` = 1.1)) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)) + scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 30, 100, 300)) + labs(x = "Fitted wet-day amount, mm (log scale)", y = "Observed, mm (log scale)") + theme_monsoon() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.35)) } # Return level curve with its 90% band and the largest observed days plot_returns <- function(curve, observed, record_years, fit_name) { curve$tip <- sprintf("%s-year day
%s mm (90%% range %s to %s)
%s fit", num(curve$T, ifelse(curve$T < 10, 1, 0)), num(curve$level, 0), num(curve$lo, 0), num(curve$hi, 0), fit_name) observed$tip <- sprintf("%s
%s mm, about once in %s years in this record", fmt_date(observed$date), num(observed$rain_mm, 1), num(observed$T, ifelse(observed$T < 10, 1, 0))) top <- max(c(curve$hi, observed$rain_mm)) ggplot(curve, aes(T)) + annotate("rect", xmin = record_years, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = INK, alpha = 0.035) + annotate("text", x = record_years * 1.08, y = top * 1.02, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = "Beyond the record:\nextrapolation", family = FONT, colour = MUTED, size = 3, lineheight = 0.95) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = WET, alpha = 0.14) + geom_line(aes(y = level), colour = WET, linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point_interactive(aes(y = level, tooltip = tip, data_id = T), colour = WET, size = 4, alpha = 0.01) + geom_point_interactive(data = observed, aes(T, rain_mm, tooltip = tip, data_id = date), colour = INK, size = 1.9) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, top * 1.04), expand = expansion(0)) + labs(x = "Return period, years (log scale)", y = "Daily rain, mm") + theme_monsoon() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.35)) } # Chance of a heavy-rain day tomorrow by state, against the cost-loss ratio plot_alert <- function(states, cl) { d <- states d$state <- factor(d$state, rev(d$state)) d$alert <- d$p_heavy > cl d$tip <- sprintf("%s
Model: %s chance of a heavy day tomorrow
Record: %s of %d days", d$state, pct(d$p_heavy, 1), pct(d$observed, 1), d$n) top <- max(c(d$p_heavy, d$observed, cl)) * 1.28 ggplot(d, aes(p_heavy, state)) + geom_col_interactive(aes(fill = alert, tooltip = tip, data_id = state), width = 0.56) + geom_point(aes(x = observed), shape = 124, size = 5.5, colour = INK) + geom_vline(xintercept = cl, colour = INK, linewidth = 0.5) + geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(alert, "Alert", "No alert"), x = top, colour = alert), hjust = 1, family = FONT, size = 3.2) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = INK, `FALSE` = MUTED)) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = WET, `FALSE` = WET_LT)) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, top), labels = function(b) pct(b, 1), expand = expansion(0)) + labs(x = "Chance of a heavy-rain day tomorrow", y = NULL) + theme_monsoon() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.35), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = INK_2, size = rel(0.95))) } # P(longest dry spell in a season > k), chain against the record plot_buffer <- function(ld, risk, k_chain) { d <- ld$curve d$tip <- sprintf("Longest dry spell over %d days
Chain: %s of seasons
Record: %s of seasons", d$k, pct(d$chain, 1), pct(d$observed, 0)) ggplot(d, aes(k)) + geom_hline(yintercept = risk, colour = INK, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "22") + geom_step(aes(y = observed), colour = DRY, linewidth = 0.6, direction = "hv") + geom_line(aes(y = chain), colour = INK_2, linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point_interactive(aes(y = chain, tooltip = tip, data_id = k), size = 3.2, colour = INK_2, alpha = 0.01) + annotate("point", x = k_chain, y = risk, colour = INK, size = 2.6) + annotate("text", x = k_chain, y = risk, label = sprintf("%d days", k_chain), hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.7, family = FONT, size = 3.3, colour = INK) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = function(b) pct(b)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) + labs(x = "Buffer, days without useful rain", y = "Seasons with a longer dry spell") + theme_monsoon() } # Every October to December day of every season plot_calendar <- function(days) { d <- days d$kind <- ifelse(is.na(d$rain_mm), "Missing", ifelse(d$rain_mm >= WET_MM, "Wet", ifelse(d$rain_mm > 0, "Light rain", "Dry"))) d$tip <- sprintf("%s
%s", fmt_date(d$date), ifelse(d$kind == "Missing", sub("missing, ", "Missing: ", d$status), paste0(num(d$rain_mm, 1), " mm"))) d$row <- factor(d$season, rev(sort(unique(d$season)))) month_starts <- c("1 Oct" = 1, "1 Nov" = 32, "1 Dec" = 62) ggplot(d, aes(dos, row)) + geom_tile_interactive(aes(fill = kind, tooltip = tip, data_id = date), colour = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.25) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Wet = WET, `Light rain` = WET_LT, Dry = DRY_LT, Missing = MISSING)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_starts, labels = names(month_starts), expand = expansion(0), position = "top") + scale_y_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1991, 2023, 2))) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_monsoon() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) }
